name: Tumble
description: The first clip is thrown away like a rigid card, tumbling end over end with a slight spin as it flies off into the distance in perspective, its darker back showing on every flip and its soft shadow shrinking on the second clip behind it. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: flips
params.description: Number of turns end over end, negative to tumble the other way

params.name: spin
params.description: Turns of the secondary spin around the line of sight

params.name: direction
params.description: Where the card flies toward on screen, in frame heights from the center (x right, y up)

params.name: shading
params.description: Shading of the card as it turns, darkness of its back and of its shadow
